name.es: Mesa fija de tilt con hincado (2P, multiposte)

description.en: Fixed-tilt ground array on several galvanized steel posts rammed (hincado) into the soil. Main beams run along the row and cross purlins carry the modules, which are fixed with anodized aluminium mid and end clamps. Reference configuration: 2P10 table, 20 modules, 12 posts, tilt 20-30 degrees, post embedment 1500 mm.
description.es: Estructura fija de tilt en suelo sobre varios postes de acero galvanizado hincados en el terreno. Vigas principales a lo largo de la fila y correas transversales que soportan los módulos, fijados con mordazas intermedias y finales de aluminio anodizado. Configuración de referencia: mesa 2P10, 20 módulos, 12 postes, tilt 20-30 grados, empotramiento de poste 1500 mm.

typical_use: Utility and commercial fixed-tilt ground arrays on soils where driving or ramming is feasible.
applicable_standards: EN 1991-1-3 (reference only, not cited by the sources)

geometry.description: Only sourced values are modelled. Post embedment 1500 mm is given; post overall length, spacing, main-beam and purlin lengths, and clamp positions are not stated and are not modelled. The origin and vertical rotation are a coordinate convention, not a sourced layout.
geometry.coordinate_system: x along module row, y up-slope/north-south horizontal, z up; origin at ground/roof contact of first support; mm and degrees

elements.note: Embedment depth 1500 mm for the 2P10 reference table (12 posts). Overall post length not stated.
6 main beams per 2P10 table (ProSolar). Length not stated; length_mm 0 is a placeholder.
8 cross purlins per 2P10 table (ProSolar). Length not stated; length_mm 0 is a placeholder.
2 diagonal bracing members per 2P10 table (ProSolar). Length and section not stated; length_mm 0 is a placeholder.

reference_layout.note: 2P10 reference: 20 modules of 2278 x 1134 x 30 mm, 12 posts, 6 main beams, 8 cross purlins, 2 diagonal bracing members. Module orientation (portrait or landscape) not stated in the source.

installation_notes: Posts are rammed or driven; the 2P10 reference uses 1500 mm embedment. Soil testing (pull-out and driving resistance) is not covered by the sources and must be defined by the engineer.
Fastener grade for structural connections is 8.8 per the source; bolt torque values were not stated and are not provided here.
ProSolar 2P10 datasheet lists tilt options of 20, 23, 25, 28 and 30 degrees (other variants on request).
